models.title: 6Level-ex-vivo-G_AB
models.description: Depth estimation generator of a Three Cycle-Consistent GAN (3cGAN) for 200 x 200 grayscale bronchoscopy images, trained on ex vivo bronchoscopic images. Artur Banach, Franklin King, Fumitaro Masaki, Hisashi Tsukada, and Nobuhiko Hata. "Visually Navigated Bronchoscopy using three cycle-Consistent generative adversarial network for depth estimation." Medical Image Analysis 73 (2021): 102164.
